text: あたまが　いたい…　ときに…　ポケモンずかんは　うまっとるかな？

structure.jp: ポケモンずかんは　うまっとるかな？
structure.en: is your Pokédex filling up, I wonder?

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: とる is an old-man dialect form of ている, which tells the state something is in. うまっとる = 'is filled in'.

patterns.name: 〜かな
patterns.explanation: かな at the end makes a soft 'I wonder' question. うまっとるかな = 'is it filling up, I wonder?'.
